prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Video 1 shows only the movement, as a rough guide: her hands go the way the hands go in video 1, at about the same moments. Above all she moves naturally, like a practised dealer, with soft, relaxed arms and hands. Her hand at the shoe strokes the yellow card out of the window and slides it flat on the felt a short way out from the shoe, where her other hand meets it. There her other hand takes it by its short end, palm down, and carries it on low over the felt, yellow side up, towards its place close in front of her, in the middle of the picture, where the last frame shows it. She lays it flat there. Then the hand that laid it glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe, as in the first frame. The hand from the shoe lets go once her other hand holds the card and settles back at the shoe. Her head stays bowed and turns towards the place where the card will lie. Only one card moves: a small card, about half as long as her hand, which keeps the size it has in the last frame all the way from the shoe to its place. It is blank, solid yellow on one side and solid blue on the other, each colour reaching right out to its corners, and the next card in the window is the same blank yellow. Only the card and the hands holding it move quickly, as in video 1; her head, her gaze and her free hand keep an ordinary, unhurried pace.

cost.basis: 21,3 krediter per s × 3 s. Liggarna b19 och b20: 7 s i 1080p = 149 krediter; listpris 23,5 per s i verktyget generate_video 2026-11-12. Prislistan 2026-11-24: 11,28 per s av 'the greater of total input duration and output duration' till 2026-11-30, sedan 14,1; referensfilmer är indata.

notes: Undantag från receptet: tur och retur i stället för bara dit; mall 15 i stället för 14; referensfilmen är dockan paows egen film (docka-paow-2-3-dc1-bestalld-c), vald med namn: en dockas film är aldrig förvald.

approval.mandate: Jakob 2026-11-24 natt (kl. 02): D.C1 stängt och D.C2 öppet som i hans plan, och ja till att D.C1 läggs om stängt i dockan. Huvudagenten dealer-d1 godkänner just dessa två filmer (paow-giv-2-3-d-02 och paow-giv-2-3-d-c2-02), en tagning var, högst 200 krediter i allt, inom mandatet dealer-d1-20261124.
